d:
Celebrate the sacred month of Shravan with the divine sounds of Raga Shivranjani, beautifully performed by the legendary flautist Pandit Hariprasad Chaurasia. Revered for its soulful and contemplative mood, this timeless raga creates an atmosphere of peace, devotion, and inner reflection. The gentle melody of the bansuri beautifully complements the spiritual significance of Shravan, a month dedicated to the worship of Lord Shiva.
Credit's:
Artist: Pandit Hariprasad Chaurasia
Perfect For:
• Shravan Month (Sawan) prayers and Shiva devotion
• Mahadev meditation and mantra chanting
